## What the metrics measure (per James 2026-05-21 13:58 CR)

**Every metric in this file is one of two things:**

### COST INPUTS (what we're spending)

**AI-cost tier:**
- Opus tokens · API fees · build hours per Forge dispatch · MCP server invocations
- Wire #3 monthly spend · voice-call monthly spend · voice-exchange per-message cost
- Per-agent run cost (recursive-optimizer · standards-keeper · cross-substrate-auditor)

**Human-utilization-cost tier (per Time Currency Ladder · 7 tiers):**
1. AI agents (free Claude tools) — lowest cost
2. Paid AI APIs
3. 3rd-party AI services
4. Contractor fiat (OneBPO · designers)
5. Existing humans in orbit (Cheyenne · Zen Village residents · First Cohort)
6. New hires
7. JamesTime (APEX · highest cost · most scarce)

### LEVERAGE OUTPUTS (what we're getting from those costs)

**Direct outputs:**
- Revenue (Camp Zen weekly · Session · Sales total)
- Treasury growth (yield % deployed · savings audited)
- Currency circulation (CORA · ZWC · paying villagers)

**Substrate-maturity outputs:**
- Sunheart Score = master cost-to-leverage ratio (how well substrate substitutes for James-cost)
- Agents LIVE-validated · proactive wires LIVE · Layer 0 hooks LIVE · specs on disk
- Substrate-without-Claude-Code % · local-model capability % · cross-surface persistence %

**Compound outputs (toward apex):**
- Scene Level (interface itself becoming cheaper for James to interact with)
- Trust-tier (less ratification overhead per substrate action)
- JamesTime → Ember (legacy investment counter)
- Time to first paying villager (proves trunk)

### The Sunheart Rule operates on the cost-to-leverage ratio

**TIME stream:** drive every action down the 7-tier human-utilization ladder · AI-cost tier first · only irreducibly-James at the apex.

**MONEY stream:** drive every dollar up the leverage ladder · substrate-compound investments first · yield second · revenue-multipliers third · reserve last.

**Both streams compound at the apex** (trillion-vision · paradise-substrate · Ember-at-FP · James-at-L5).

**Sunheart Score = the headline cost-to-leverage ratio.** When it moves up · we're routing more work/dollar to substrate per James-cost spent. Static = drift. Up = compounding.

## INTENT (the apex · what every metric serves)

- **The trillion-vision** — paradise-on-earth substrate scaled to a trillion lives
- **Camp Zen Continuous Village** — physical-Costa-Rica embodiment of paradise-substrate · funded by recurring revenue · replicated at scale
